title: Allocate available stock
preconditions: Librarian session; active student; no fine; fixture stock set for case
main: 3 copies -> issue -> 2 copies and one ISSUED loan
exceptions: Unknown ISBN -> explanatory rejection; all stock unchanged
postconditions: Exactly one copy consumed on success; no stock/loan change on rejection

title: Return the correct loan record
preconditions: Librarian session; synthetic issued loan options loaded
main: Select first of two loans -> only first returned
alternatives: Prior returned history plus active second -> preserve history and return second
exceptions: Selected record deleted after form load -> reject, no stock credit
Selected record closed by another operator -> reject, no duplicate stock credit
postconditions: Only selected eligible record changes; unrelated records preserved; no extra fine
